transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Um... well, I suppose I'm just here because... things have gotten very quiet lately. I used to enjoy things. My work, yoga, going to galleries... even just journaling. But that part of me that used to reach out for people or take pleasure in those things is just... gone. I'm mostly just going through the motions now. Fulfilling obligations. That's what finally brought me in.
About how long have you been feeling this way?

About eight months, I suppose. It started... well, we took an older relative into our apartment around then. And since that happened, this whole shift in how I'm thinking, and working... or connecting with anyone... it's just been going on since then.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life?
No. Not really. I've never... felt quite like this before.
Aside from losing interest in things, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or empty most days?
No. I wouldn't say sad. Or down. I just... I haven't really noticed feeling much of anything, to be honest. Just... like I said before.
How has your sleep been over these past several months?
It's been fine, I suppose. I haven't really paid much attention to it... just sleeping normally, I guess.
How have your energy levels been over these past few months?
They've been fine, I guess. I haven't... really noticed a change. Just about the same as usual.
Have you been feeling anxious, nervous, or on edge at all during this time?
No, not really. I don't think so. Just... normal, I suppose.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or that life isn't worth living?
No... nothing like that. I haven't had any thoughts like that.
